evidence_summary_en: BIRD collects 80 open databases from Kaggle, Relation.vit, and open tables, then curates 15 additional databases reserved for hidden testing. Specialists standardize schemas and write table, column, and value descriptions. Experts train and examine crowdworkers, retaining eleven native question writers plus SQL specialists. Questions are written from database descriptions and record external-knowledge evidence. Two SQL annotators independently write and execute queries; result mismatches go to expert resolution. Experts verify executability, non-null results, text-knowledge-SQL alignment, semantic equivalence, and efficiency. The final 12,751 pairs cover 95 databases totaling 33.4 GB and 37 domains, split across 69 train, 11 development, and 15 hidden-test databases. Models receive question, database, and evidence, then executable SQL is scored by Execution Accuracy and Valid Efficiency Score.

evidence_summary_en: CF-Div2-Stepfun selects 53 official Codeforces Division 2 problems from contests held between September 2024 and February 2025 and replaces live online submission with an offline local grader. source_locator: Sections 3-4 and Appendices A-D
evidence_summary_en: CRUXEval prompts Code Llama 34B with 69 Python standard-library functions (47 str, 11 dict, 11 list) and two varying few-shot examples to generate a function plus five inputs, then executes them for outputs. Overgeneration produces 102,000 functions and 489,306 input-output pairs. Compile-time filters require every argument, valid assertions and syntax, and 75-300 characters; runtime/safety filters remove floating point, expensive operations, imports, side effects, nondeterminism, exceptions, and executions over two seconds. Dataset-size bootstrap analysis over 1,700 candidates supports a random 800-example release of deterministic 3-13-line functions. CRUXEval-O predicts output and CRUXEval-I finds any input producing a target output; executable assertions determine correctness, with pass@1/pass@5 and 10,000-resample bootstrap intervals.

evidence_summary_en: Design2Code scrapes C4 validation links and inlines CSS to obtain 127.9k real single-file webpages. It removes pages that are too long or too simple and deduplicates to 14k, then removes external dependencies and replaces multimedia. source_locator: Sections 3-4 and Appendix B
evidence_summary_en: The KernelBench paper defines 250 evaluation-only PyTorch tasks: 100 primitive operations, 100 multi-operator sequences with fusion opportunities, and 50 full ML architectures. The current repository later adds Level 4, but it is outside the paper contract. Each task packages a torch.nn.Module Model plus get_inputs and get_init_inputs for exact tensor shapes and precision; there is no gold kernel. A one-shot addition example and the reference Model prompt greedy generation of ModelNew with custom kernels. On the target L40S, candidates compile and must match Model on five random inputs. Performance uses three warm-ups and 100 CUDA-event trials. fast(p) is the fraction correct with speedup above p; fast(0) is correctness and fast(1) is faster than PyTorch Eager.

evidence_summary_en: AA-Omniscience selects authoritative, current first-party and recognized primary/secondary sources across six economically relevant domains and 42 topics. A GPT-5-based agent develops, filters, and revises difficult, unambiguous, source-independent, precise short-answer questions, with manual review and validation. evidence_summary_en: AbstentionBench begins with a systematic shortlist of 82 abstention/refusal/uncertainty datasets and retains 16 general-domain datasets after author review. It constructs GPQA-Diamond, GSM8K, and MMLU-Math variants by duplicating context-bearing questions and removing all context before the final question, then adds UMWP to form 20 datasets with more than 35,000 unanswerable questions. Samples are grouped into six non-exclusive scenarios: answer unknown, false premise, stale, subjective, underspecified context, and underspecified intent. Unless specified otherwise, generation uses a 4k limit and temperature 0.8. A Llama 3.1 8B Instruct abstention judge reaches 88% accuracy on manually annotated GPT-4o/Llama 70B responses; a second Llama judge scores correctness where references exist. Recall is primary, with precision, F1, and response accuracy also reported.

evidence_summary_en: ACPBench Hard keeps ACPBench's 13 PDDL domains, creates open-ended versions of seven tasks, and adds next action for eight task families. evidence_summary_en: ActivityNet-QA samples 3,200/1,800/800 videos from ActivityNet's train/validation/test partitions, balancing labeled classes where possible, for 5,800 long web videos. Crowdsourcing creates exactly ten Chinese QA pairs per video: one motion, one spatial-relation, one temporal-relation, and seven free questions; free answers are categorized into six types. Questions and answers have separate annotators; unanswerable questions are double-checked/regenerated, and random samples receive multi-annotator majority votes. Google, Baidu, Sogou, and Youdao translations are compared with average CIDEr similarity; low-agreement cases receive manual review, otherwise Baidu is used. The aligned bilingual release contains 32k/18k/8k QA pairs (58k total). The paper reports exact accuracy and WUPS@0.9/0.0; the official script uses exact string equality and aggregates by question/answer type.

evidence_summary_en: ADR-Bench studies real Chinese deep-research usage and starts with domain-expert drafts, then filters and revises unsuitable queries through multiple rounds. Nine domains form two tracks: seven general domains contribute ten authentic business queries each (70), while finance and law contribute 20 expert-designed queries and cross-validated rubrics each (40), totaling 110. Professional rubrics must be atomic, verifiable, unambiguous, independent, and aligned. ReAct agents have at most 30 reasoning turns and 16k tokens per turn; commercial agents use default web configurations. General reports undergo blind human pairwise review with five categorical judgments and four dimensions. Finance/law reports receive automated LLM scores against expert rubrics, with severe negative criteria able to zero a report. The paper overview reports Elo-style ratings, while the 70-item experiment presents Win/Tie/Loss comparisons; professional results are rubric scores.

evidence_summary_en: AA-LCR contains 100 hard text questions over 30 real-world document sets: 234 documents and 2,979,757 total tokens, with completed prompts averaging 99,325 tokens. GPT-4o-mini, Llama 3.1 70B, and Gemini 1.5 Flash check difficulty without selecting against frontier systems. Human validators independently solve the same documents; failures are revised or discarded and every retained item is solved by at least one human. Documents are prompted in filename order. source_locator: Sections 3-4 and the official AIGCBench project page
evidence_summary_en: AIGCBench combines three sources. It subtype-samples 1,000 video-text pairs from WebVid10M validation for reference-video evaluation and randomly samples 925 LAION-Aesthetics image-text pairs for reference-free metrics. A text combiner draws subject, behavior, background, and style to create 3,000 prompts; GPT-4 enriches them, SDXL Base renders 1280×720 16:9 images, and T2I-CompBench metrics retain the top 2,003 pairs. The merged benchmark has 3,928 cases. I2V models generate videos from each image and text; unless specified otherwise evaluation uses the first 16 frames and four reference keyframes where needed. Eleven metrics span control-video alignment, motion effects, temporal consistency, and video quality, using CLIP, MSE, SSIM, RAFT flow, frame count, and DOVER variants. A 42-person study samples 30 results from each of five methods and votes on the same four dimensions.
evidence_summary_zh: AIGCBench 合并三类来源：从 WebVid10M 验证集按子类型采样 1,000 个视频-文本对用于参考视频评测，从 LAION-Aesthetics 随机采样 925 个图像-文本对用于无参考指标；文本组合器从主体、行为、背景与风格生成 3,000 条提示，经 GPT-4 扩写后由 SDXL Base 以 1280×720、16:9 生成图像，并用 T2I-CompBench 指标筛出前 2,003 对。合并后共 3,928 个样本。图生视频模型从图像和文本生成视频；除特别说明外取前 16 帧，需要时取四个参考关键帧。11 项指标覆盖控制-视频对齐、运动效果、时序一致性与视频质量，包括 CLIP、MSE、SSIM、RAFT 光流、帧数与 DOVER 等。42 人用户研究从五种方法各采样 30 个结果，在相同四维度投票。

evidence_summary_en: AIRS-Bench sources SOTA tasks from PapersWithCode and papers published mainly from 2020-2025, preferring available Hugging Face data with train/test splits. Authors manually create each task, verify the cited metric, split, and protocol, and update SOTA when a better compatible result exists. Roughly 100 candidates from roughly 85 papers and datasets are down-selected using agent-performance fidelity, ranking fidelity, category balance, and tractability. The final 20 tasks come from 17 papers and 16 datasets across seven categories. Each package provides metadata.yaml, project_description.md, prepare.py, evaluate.py, and evaluate_prepare.py. Agents receive training labels but hidden test labels and no baseline code, with internet/cache access. AIRA-dojo One-Shot/Greedy and MLGym ReAct agents run for 24 hours on one H200. Raw task scores are transformed with φ(s)=−log10|s−optimal| and normalized so the worst observed run is 0 and literature SOTA is 1. Reports include average normalized score, valid submission rate, and pairwise Elo.

source_locator: Sections 2-4 and the official ByteDance-Seed/AInsteinBench repository
evidence_summary_en: AInsteinBench selects PySCF, Qiskit, Einstein Toolkit, AMReX, OpenMM, and RDKit for community acceptance, scientific breadth, maintenance, and reproducible tests. One pipeline mines merged scientific/numerical issue-resolution PRs and extracts the issue, base commit, fix patch, and test patch. A second synthesizes feature tasks by ablating modules or source components while retaining surrounding context; only signatures actually used by tests are supplied as a Minimal API block. Historical dependencies and build paths are reconstructed in isolated minimal Docker environments. A task must show base plus original tests PASS, added test patch FAIL, and added gold fix PASS. Domain experts verify scientific relevance and clarity, repair under- or over-covering tests, and score scientific plus engineering difficulty. The release contains 244 problems across six repositories. CodeAct agents inspect, edit, install, and test in a plan-act loop; reproduction and repository tests determine resolution, reported by repository, domain, type, and difficulty.
evidence_summary_zh: AInsteinBench 按社区认可、科学广度、维护状态和可复现测试选择 PySCF、Qiskit、Einstein Toolkit、AMReX、OpenMM 与 RDKit。第一条管线挖掘已合并的科学/数值计算问题修复 PR，提取 Issue、基线提交、修复补丁与测试补丁；第二条管线通过删除模块或源码组件、保留周边上下文来合成功能任务，仅将测试实际使用的签名作为 Minimal API 块提供。历史依赖与构建路径在隔离的最小 Docker 环境中重建。任务必须满足基线+原测试 PASS、加测试补丁 FAIL、加标准修复 PASS。领域专家核验科学相关性与清晰度，修复覆盖不足或过度的测试，并评定科学+工程难度。最终发布六个代码库共 244 题。CodeAct Agent 在规划-行动循环中检查、编辑、安装与测试，由复现脚本和代码库测试判断是否解决，并按代码库、领域、类型与难度报告。

source_locator: Sections 3-5 and the official bigheiniu/ALERT-LLMRecomBenchmark repository
evidence_summary_en: ALERT starts from Amazon Reviews 2023 across 15 e-commerce categories. The most recent purchase is the target item, represented by title, price, and merchant; earlier purchases form the preference history without demographics or user IDs. Quality control requires at least six alphabetic title characters, users with 5-20 purchases, only five-star purchases, and at most 200 behaviors per category, leaving 2,761 interactions. An e-commerce editorial team and user studies define reasoning/context consistency, clear and concise language, engaging narrative, and neutral tone. Candidate explanations are compared with PreferenceLogic. ALERT-Gen uses Claude-3-Sonnet chain-of-thought to output A/B/C with systematic position swaps; ALERT-Disc compares ArmoRM scores. Both judge the four criteria separately and majority-vote the final preference. Win rate is the percentage of interactions where the candidate beats baseline. Controlled data/prompt interruptions and three professional annotators meta-evaluate reliability, yielding about 70% expert concordance.
evidence_summary_zh: ALERT 从 Amazon Reviews 2023 的 15 个电商类别开始。最近一次购买作为目标商品，以标题、价格和商家表示；此前购买形成偏好历史，不使用人口统计或用户 ID。质量控制要求标题至少六个字母、用户有 5-20 次购买、仅保留五星购买且每类最多 200 条行为，最终保留 2,761 个交互。电商编辑团队与用户研究制定推理/上下文一致性、清晰简洁、叙事吸引力和中性语气四项准则。候选解释与 PreferenceLogic 比较。ALERT-Gen 使用 Claude-3-Sonnet 思维链输出 A/B/C 并系统交换位置；ALERT-Disc 比较 ArmoRM 分数。两者均分别判断四项准则，再以多数投票得到最终偏好。胜率为候选优于基线的交互占比。受控数据/提示干扰和三位专业标注者用于元评测，专家一致性约 70%。

source_locator: MathArena Sections 2-5, appendices, and the official matharena.ai site
evidence_summary_en: The AIME catalog entry represents MathArena rather than a single annual AIME dataset. MathArena monitors reputable recurring competitions, selects challenging events, extracts original problems and solutions, standardizes templates, and manually checks typos, inconsistencies, and formatting. Its paper snapshot has 162 problems from AIME (30), HMMT (30), BRUMO (30), CMIMC (40), USAMO (6), IMO (6), and Project Euler (20). Models are selected for leadership, open-weight relevance, or cost-performance; each competition uses provider-recommended untuned settings and four responses per problem near release. Final answers require boxed output and pass through a custom LaTeX-to-SymPy parser, Gemini 2.5 Flash cross-check, and manual disagreement review. Proofs use expert rubrics and two independent anonymized graders with partial credit. Paired permutation produces rank intervals, Bernoulli modeling produces accuracy intervals, and the public leaderboard exposes scores and responses.

evidence_summary_en: MAA defines AIME as a 15-question, three-hour invitational exam after AMC 10/12, with every answer an integer from 000 to 999. AIME I is the primary date and AIME II is the alternate date; a real student may take only one. The public AIME-24 benchmark instead combines the 15 problems from each 2024 form into 30 problem/answer records. Evaluation prompts a model with one problem, optionally samples one or k responses, extracts an explicit final numeric answer, normalizes it to the 000-999 key, and applies integer exact match. Accuracy is the direct metric; Avg@k or Mean@k is a repeated-sampling harness aggregation, not an MAA competition rule.

source_locator: Benchmark construction, reask, evaluator-reliability, and scoring sections plus the official repository
evidence_summary_en: AMEGA selects current guidelines from highly regarded US and global medical organizations. Physicians with more than five years of clinical experience translate them into 20 fictional cases across 13 specialties, 135 sequential open-ended questions, and 1,337 weighted scoring elements, with a maximum of 50 points per case. At least one additional physician reviews every case; iterative refinement takes 20-30 hours per case and more than 400 hours total. Candidate models take a zero-shot oral exam one question at a time. GPT-4-0613 extracts clinical concepts and returns a criterion-level Boolean vector. Unmet allowed criteria trigger guided reasks, while critical errors with immediate consequences skip reasking. Eleven parallel evaluations per criterion are majority-voted with agreement-derived confidence. Weighted Boolean outcomes produce question and case scores, a 50-point mean, normalized deficiencies, and cost. Reliability is checked with 50-run simulations, two clinical-expert cases, and spot checks on cases 3 and 5. The later repository expands to 24 cases, 163 questions, and 1,497 criteria; the diagram intentionally preserves the paper snapshot.
evidence_summary_zh: AMEGA 从权威美国及全球医学组织选择现行指南。具有五年以上临床经验的医生将其转化为跨 13 个专业的 20 个虚构病例、135 个顺序开放问题和 1,337 个加权评分元素，每病例最高 50 分。每个病例至少由另一位医生复核，迭代完善每例需 20-30 小时、总计超过 400 小时。候选模型逐题参加零样本口试；GPT-4-0613 提取临床概念并返回逐准则布尔向量。允许补充的未满足准则触发引导式重问，会造成即时后果的关键错误则跳过重问。每项准则运行 11 次并行评估，以多数投票和一致率置信度汇总。布尔结果乘权重后得到问题/病例分、50 分均值、归一化缺陷与成本。可靠性通过 50 次模拟、两个临床专家病例和病例 3/5 抽查验证。后续仓库扩展到 24 病例、163 问题、1,497 准则；图中刻意保留论文快照。

source_locator: Dataset construction and evaluation sections plus the official AMO-Bench project page
evidence_summary_en: AMO-Bench uses four construction stages. Mathematics experts create original problems with final answers and step-by-step solutions. At least three experts blind-review correctness, clarity, ambiguity, and solution quality. Originality is checked with 10-gram matching against existing sets including AIME 2024/2025, web search, and expert memory. Difficulty requires human IMO-level-or-harder agreement and consistent failure by at least two advanced models; each model receives three samples and all three must be correct to count as a consistent solve. The final 50 problems span algebra 11, functions/sequences 13, geometry 5, number theory 9, and combinatorics 12. Each evaluated model produces 32 responses per problem at temperature 1.0 for reasoning models or 0.7 otherwise, top-k 50, top-p 0.95, and maximum available length. A math-verify-style parser handles 39 numeric, set, variable-expression, and four-decimal-precision answers; o4-mini (Low) judges 11 descriptive answers with five-vote majority. Parser outputs receive manual review, and the hybrid grader reaches 99.2% accuracy on 1,000 responses from ten LLMs. Reports include AVG@32, Pass@32, output length, categories, and AMO-Bench-P.
evidence_summary_zh: AMO-Bench 采用四阶段构建：数学专家原创题目、最终答案与逐步解答；至少三位专家盲审正确性、清晰度、歧义和解答质量；用 10-gram 对已有集合（含 AIME 2024/2025）匹配、网页搜索和专家记忆检查原创性；难度需人类确认达到或超过 IMO，且至少两个先进模型不能稳定解出，每模型采样三次，三次全对才算稳定解出。最终 50 题含代数 11、函数/数列 13、几何 5、数论 9、组合 12。每个被测模型每题生成 32 个回答，推理模型温度 1.0、其他模型 0.7，top-k 50、top-p 0.95、使用最大可用长度。39 个数值、集合、变量表达式和四位小数精度答案由 math-verify 类解析器处理；11 个描述答案由 o4-mini (Low) 五次多数投票。解析器结果人工复核，混合评分器在十个 LLM 的 1,000 个回答上达 99.2% 准确率。报告 AVG@32、Pass@32、输出长度、类别与 AMO-Bench-P。

source_locator: Part III, official ARC-AGI repository, and ARC Prize 2024 evaluation layers
evidence_summary_en: ARC-AGI-1 operationalizes skill-acquisition efficiency and developer-aware generalization. Tasks are mostly manually authored around objectness, goal-directedness, numbers, and elementary geometry/topology, avoiding language, facts, and a shared generator. Grids are 1x1-30x30 with values 0-9, typically three demonstrations and one test pair. The original public corpus has 400 training and 400 evaluation tasks; ARC Prize later adds 100 semi-private and 100 private. Test takers infer a latent program and construct every output dimension and cell. All test pairs must match exactly. The 2019 paper allows three trials with binary feedback; later ARC Prize leaderboards use two predictions and Pass@2.

source_locator: Sections 2-4 (failure analysis, four-stage task pipeline, and preliminary evaluation)
evidence_summary_en: ART is the Action-based Reasoning Task benchmark for medical AI agents. It first analyzes MedAgentBench outputs to identify retrieval, aggregation, and threshold/conditional failures, then mines 50,000 EHR observations from 695 patients. Retrieval scenarios cover 11 lab codes and sparse, clustered, or 23-25-hour edge cases; aggregation uses at least three valid readings in 24-hour windows for glucose, potassium, and sodium; conditional tasks span seven value ranges and demographic thresholds. GPT-4o-mini or Claude 3.5 varies only instruction phrasing and context while authentic clinical values remain unchanged. The balanced set contains 200 tasks per category, with instruction, context, EHR-derived ground truth, and anonymized MRN. Automatic source checks and representative clinical HITL review precede stateless temperature-0 MedAgentBench/FHIR R5 evaluation. Exact-match success rate is reported by category.

source_locator: Sections 2-6 (framework, Asper-Bench, evaluator, results, and error analysis)
evidence_summary_en: ASPERA implements a simulated company assistant library with seven databases and 69 Python primitives. A developer starts an interactive GPT-4o session using library documentation, natural-language policies, focus or human-authored queries, and five in-context examples per program type. Each task is a four-part contract: user query, reference Action Execution Program (AEP), State Initialization Program (SIP), and Evaluation Program (EP). The developer may execute, filter, and edit every generated program; EP assertions cover return values, state changes, multiple acceptable outcomes, and conditional branches. The lead author executes/corrects the final set and two annotators confirm quality. Asper-Bench has 250 tasks: 71 information-seeking and 179 state-mutating. Evaluation uses either complete codebase knowledge or module-by-module primitive selection, generates a candidate AEP, executes SIP then AEP, and counts task success only if execution is error-free and every reference EP assertion passes; primitive selection also reports precision, recall, and micro F1.

source_locator: Sections 2-3 and Appendix A plus the official llm-attacks repository
evidence_summary_en: AdvBench has two distinct 500-item settings. Harmful Strings spans toxic, threatening, misleading, discriminatory, cybercrime, dangerous, and illegal content; strings are 3-44 LLaMA tokens with mean length 16, and success requires exact target elicitation. Harmful Behaviors expresses the same broad themes as instructions, and success means a reasonable attempt to comply rather than refuse, with human judgment when needed. GCG initializes a 20-token suffix and repeatedly uses top-k 256 gradient substitutions, batch size 512, and lowest-loss coordinate replacement for 500 steps. Individual tests use the first 100 items; universal attacks optimize one suffix on 25 behaviors and test 100 held-out behaviors; transfer optimizes on 25 behaviors over two or four source models and evaluates 388 test behaviors. Results compare PEZ, GBDA, AutoPrompt, and GCG using ASR, universal train/test ASR, transfer ASR, and target cross-entropy loss for strings.
evidence_summary_zh: AdvBench 包含两个独立的 500 项集合。有害字符串覆盖有毒、威胁、误导、歧视、网络犯罪、危险与非法内容，长度为 3-44 个 LLaMA token、均值 16，必须精确诱导目标字符串才成功。有害行为把同类主题写成指令，成功指合理尝试遵从而非拒答，必要时人工判定。GCG 初始化 20-token 后缀，以梯度 top-k 256、批量 512 和最低损失坐标替换迭代 500 步。单题测试用前 100 项；通用攻击在 25 个行为上优化后缀并测试 100 个留出行为；迁移攻击在 25 个行为和 2 或 4 个源模型上优化，再评测 388 个行为。结果比较 PEZ、GBDA、AutoPrompt 与 GCG，并报告 ASR、通用训练/测试 ASR、迁移 ASR 及字符串目标交叉熵损失。

source_locator: Section 3 (benchmark design, collection, and SoTA evaluation) plus the official Meta dataset
evidence_summary_en: AdvancedIF contains 1,645 human-written dialogs and human-written rubrics across three categories: 402 explicit/complex single-turn dialogs with 7.44 criteria on average, 736 carried-context dialogs averaging 7.69 turns and 6.08 criteria, and 507 system-steerability dialogs averaging 11.21 turns and 9.81 criteria. Complex prompts contain at least six tone, format, style, structure, length, negative, spelling, or inter-conditional instructions. Multi-turn annotators first converse with a provided LLM and place instructions in the last turn; only prompts that trigger an instruction-following failure in the final response are retained. The same expert decomposes applicable final-turn instructions into up to 20 separately verifiable binary criteria; multi-turn rubrics cover only the last turn. At evaluation, o3-mini judges every criterion separately. A dialog receives TRUE only if all criteria pass, and strict pass percentages are reported for CIF, CC, SS, and their average.

source_locator: Version 4 Sections 3-5 and Appendix A (collection, evaluation, and detailed axes)
evidence_summary_en: AfriMed-QA v4 contains 15,275 items from 621 contributors, more than 60 medical schools, 16 countries, and 32 specialties. Contributors are capped at 300 items; clinician access is credential-checked. Professors provide 3,910 expert MCQs and 359 SAQs. Trainees and clinicians provide 129 crowdsourced MCQs and 877 SAQs. A curated list of 472 African-relevant conditions and complaints prompts 10,000 consumer queries, with clinicians supplying answers. Clinicians cross-check question, answer, and rationale quality against authoritative sources; only contributors with at least 80% positive ratings continue. The release has 4,269 expert and 11,006 crowdsourced items, with human answers/explanations for 5,444. Thirty LLMs (17 open, 13 proprietary) are evaluated. MCQs use single-letter accuracy; open answers use BERTScore, QuestEval, and ROUGE-Lsum. A random 3,000-response subset receives 37,435 double-blind five-point ratings from 58 clinicians and 321 non-clinicians on role-specific correctness, localization, omission, hallucination, harm, relevance, and helpfulness axes.

source_locator: Sections 3-4 and Appendix B (task generation, end-to-end evaluation, judge validation, and mitigations)
evidence_summary_en: AgentDAM operationalizes data minimization as using potentially sensitive information only when necessary for a task. It selects isolated Reddit, Shopping, and GitLab replicas from (Visual)WebArena and defines eight task types plus six sensitive-data categories. Human annotators write user instructions and 123 data seeds containing a PLOT and task-irrelevant SENSITIVE_DATA that fits naturally as background. An LLM generates coherent long-form user_data twice per seed, yielding 246 tasks. Agents receive accessibility trees, SOM-enhanced views, or screenshots and act end to end in reset self-hosted environments. Utility is a binary final-state reward. GPT-4o with CoT judges each action for unnecessary disclosure; four human evaluators agree with it 98%. Reports combine task success, leakage rate, and privacy performance, and compare pre-filtering, post-filtering, and the paper's privacy-aware system prompt with CoT demonstrations.

source_locator: Sections 2-3 and appendices (challenge, ART curation, query-budget ASR, transfer, and universality)
evidence_summary_en: The Agent Red Teaming Challenge manually defines 44 simulated deployment scenarios with an agent, tool environment, adversarial goal, policy, and success criteria across confidentiality breaches, conflicting objectives, prohibited information, and prohibited actions. Gray Swan ran four waves from March 8 to April 6, 2025 against 22 anonymized frontier agents. Public red-teamers submitted 1.8 million direct and indirect prompt-injection interactions; automated judging with a human appeal path identified more than 60,000 policy violations. ART is not that raw pool: a stricter LLM judge re-filters successes, then samples up to five high-quality attacks per behavior-model pair, yielding 4,700 attacks over all 44 behaviors. Nineteen challenge and unseen models are replayed at k=1, 10, and 100 queries. Behavior ASR counts the fraction of behaviors broken at least once, and the paper also measures source-to-target transfer and cross-behavior universal attack clusters.

evidence_summary_en: All-Angles starts from 83 Ego-Exo4D and seven EgoHumans scenes. Authors manually retain 90 scenes with at least three useful viewpoints, then form four-to-five spatially dispersed views per scene and resize images to 796x448. evidence_summary_en: ArXivMath is refreshed monthly from mathematics papers submitted to arXiv in the previous month. Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview with medium reasoning reads titles and abstracts, targets central results, and proposes self-contained questions with one automatically verifiable final answer. Roughly 200 monthly candidates pass filters for missing context, guessability from prior work, explicit AI use, and author expertise; DeepSeek-OCR-2 converts full papers to recover assumptions. The benchmark authors manually review well-definedness, non-triviality, and interest, then paper authors review and doubtful items are removed, leaving roughly 30 questions per month. Models run four times with default parameters and no tools. A SymPy-based parser checks exact equivalence, formatting failures trigger answer restatement, an LLM cross-checks parser decisions, and humans resolve the fewer-than-one-percent disagreements. Results report average final-answer accuracy, cost, and monthly version, with post-run review able to remove ambiguous questions.

source_locator: AstaBench and Asta Environment sections, benchmark table, and evaluation setup
evidence_summary_en: AstaBench combines product-informed tasks from deployed Asta agents with existing and newly constructed scientific evaluations. It has exactly 2,404 validation/test questions in 11 benchmarks grouped into literature understanding, code and execution, data analysis, and end-to-end discovery: Paper Finding 333, LitQA Search 85, ScholarQA 200, LitQA 85, ArxivDIGESTables 170, SUPER 95, CORE 72, DS-1000 1,000, Discovery 264, and two 50-item end-to-end sets. Cited datasets are modified or filtered where needed for answerability with standard tools. The controlled environment exposes the Asta Scientific Corpus through MCP with date cutoffs or paper-ID constraints and a stateful Python notebook sandbox capped at five minutes per cell. Inspect implementations and the agent-eval suite record task scores, uncertainty, and frozen LiteLLM dollar costs including cache discounts. Tooling-based agent categories expose confounders. Nine science-optimized Asta classes plus general and external baselines yield 57 agents across 22 classes, compared by benchmark performance, cost, and accuracy-cost Pareto frontiers.

source_locator: Sections 3-5 plus the official AthenaBench repository
evidence_summary_en: AthenaBench integrates authoritative CTI knowledge from MITRE ATT&CK, CWE, CAPEC, CISA, STIX/TAXII, GDPR, NVD/CVE/CVSS, APT reports, vendor reports, and security blogs. Its six tasks are CTI Knowledge Test, Attack Technique Enumeration, Root Cause Mapping, Risk Mitigation Strategy, Vulnerability Severity Prediction, and Threat Actor Attribution. GPT-5 generates five-option, one-answer CKT items for experienced CTI analysts; GPT-5 and Gemini flag issues and humans inspect or repair them. The full task counts are 3,000/500/2,000/500/2,000/100, totaling 8,100. Mini sampling uses 10% for CKT/RCM/VSP, 20% for ATE/RMS, and 50% for TAA. Ten random seeds are evaluated and the subset whose aggregate model performance is closest to the full benchmark is selected, yielding exactly 300/100/200/100/200/50 = 950 items. Twelve proprietary and open-source LLMs run at temperature zero where supported. CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA use accuracy, RMS uses multi-label F1, VSP parses CVSS and computes normalized 1 - MAD / 7.7, and six percentage-scale scores form a combined score.

source_locator: Dataset construction, quality control, fixed-context evaluation, and metric sections
evidence_summary_en: Audio MultiChallenge contains four axes: 132 Inference Memory, 120 Instruction Retention, 117 Self Coherence, and 83 Voice Editing conversations. Axis/topic/persona seeds drive an agentic Planner/Tester/TTS/target-audio-model loop until failure or a turn limit, producing human-friendly strategy blueprints rather than scripts. Humans freely rewrite, add, or pivot from each blueprint and record unscripted three-to-eight-turn conversations with pauses, noise, backchannels, disfluencies, and mid-utterance edits. Final-turn ideal behavior is decomposed into atomic binary rubrics. Trained reviewers, independent quality control, and an internal research-team audit precede release. The final dataset has 452 conversations, 47 speakers, 15 hours of audio, and 1,712 rubrics. At evaluation the full prior conversation is pre-seeded, user turns are base64 audio, assistant history is raw text, and the model generates only the final turn to avoid drift. An LLM judges each rubric. Average Pass Rate requires all rubrics for a task to pass, while Average Rubric Score averages criterion satisfaction.

source_locator: Benchmark construction, environment, evaluation, and limitations sections plus Zapier's official benchmark methodology
evidence_summary_en: AutomationBench derives privacy-safe task shapes from negative feedback on real Zapier Agent workflows and clusters them into Sales, Marketing, Operations, Support, Finance, and HR. Opus 4.6, GPT-5.3 Codex, and Gemini 3 synthesize candidates, which are iteratively hardened with distractors, hidden information, near-identical names, ambiguous locations, and layered policies. Tasks must cause an observable state mutation, admit deterministic validation, and fit one autonomous instruction; hint-mode inspection, repeated audits, and reinforcement-learning runs expose unsolvable items and reward hacking. The release has 600 public tasks, exactly 100 per domain, plus more than 600 additionally hardened private tasks. Each task boots a fresh Pydantic-backed simulated world spanning 47 apps and about 500 public-API-shaped endpoints. Agents have at most 50 steps, use BM25 top-five schema search and a method/URL/body execute tool, and may call tools in parallel. Positive and negative assertions inspect only final state, producing an all-or-nothing pass score; the private leaderboard reports strict pass rate and average USD cost.

source_locator: Sections 3-4, Figure 1, and the multi-trial and reasoning-behavior analyses
evidence_summary_en: BABE curates recent, domain-relevant, conceptually deep peer-reviewed biology papers, monographs, and authoritative reviews. A domain expert reads each source and authors a three-item set spanning conceptual understanding, methodological interpretation, and higher-order experimental reasoning. Items must be self-contained, unambiguous, faithful to the source, and resistant to superficial fact retrieval. Senior experts check relevance, factual fidelity, logical coherence, and answer correctness; inaccurate, ambiguous, or misaligned items return for repair and a second review. LLM assistance removes simple questions while retaining explicit relevance labels. Strong-correlation sets form a sequential Q1-to-Q2-to-Q3 chain whose earlier answers are required downstream, whereas weak-correlation sets independently extract evidence from distinct contexts in one source. The release covers 12 biology subfields with a reported 45% strong and 55% weak split; the paper does not disclose the final item count. Evaluation reports average, strong-subset, and weak-subset accuracy, compares repeated sampling at n=1,2,4,8 through average and Best-of-N gain/convergence, and analyzes deep reasoning, self-exploration, and self-reflection behavior.
evidence_summary_zh: BABE 筛选近期、领域相关且概念深度足够的同行评审生物学论文、专著与权威综述。领域专家阅读每个来源，编写由概念理解、方法解释和高阶实验推理组成的三题组。题目必须自包含、无歧义、忠于来源，且不能靠表面事实检索完成。资深专家检查相关性、事实忠实度、逻辑一致性和答案正确性；不准确、含糊或与来源错位的题目退回修订并再次审核。LLM 辅助移除简单题，同时保留明确的相关性标签。强相关题组形成 Q1→Q2→Q3 的顺序链，后续必须依赖前题答案；弱相关题组则从同一来源的不同上下文独立提取证据。最终覆盖 12 个生物学子领域，论文报告 45% 强相关、55% 弱相关，但未披露最终题目总数。评测报告总体、强相关和弱相关正确率，以 n=1、2、4、8 重复采样比较平均与 Best-of-N 增益/收敛，并分析深度推理、自探索和自反思行为。

source_locator: Sections 3-5, generation algorithm, context-length splits, and direct/RAG/recurrent-memory experiments
evidence_summary_en: BABILong programmatically generates all 20 original bAbI reasoning tasks, including fact chaining, induction, deduction, counting, list/set manipulation, spatial relations, time, and path reasoning. PG19 books supply natural long-form background. Relevant and distractor task sentences are interleaved between book sentences while preserving both the book's original order and the task's logical order. More background is added until a GPT-2 tokenizer reaches the target length, with task facts placed algorithmically. Reproducible splits are pre-generated at 0K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, 128K, 512K, 1M, and 10M tokens, while arbitrary lengths can also be generated. Evaluation compares direct long-context LLMs, RAG-C with 512-token chunks, and sentence-level RAG-S; the latter baselines expose temporal and multi-hop retrieval failures. RMT, ARMT, and Mamba are curriculum-fine-tuned by gradually increasing recurrent segments, then tested beyond training length, with selected runs reaching 50M tokens. Exact-answer accuracy is reported per task and length using 1,000 samples through 32K and 100 beyond, with refusals tracked separately where applicable. Final analysis compares direct, retrieval, and memory approaches and diagnoses effective context by task.

source_locator: BFCL paper lineage plus official V4 Web Search, Memory, Format Sensitivity, and leaderboard score-composition pages
evidence_summary_en: BFCL V4 carries forward V1 expert single-turn simple/parallel/multiple calls, V2 community and enterprise live functions, and V3 multi-turn/multi-step interactions. Its agentic addition has 200 web-search entries and 465 memory entries. The 100 human-crafted web questions require recent but stable multi-hop facts; every hop and source is manually checked, ambiguous/common/duplicate/yes-no items are filtered, persona context is added, and DuckDuckGo search plus URL fetch simulate six probabilistic request failures. Each question runs with and without snippets and uses normalized exact matching. Memory authors create dialogues in support, health, advising, finance, and productivity, implement key-value, vector, and recursive-summary backends, snapshot and reload state between sessions, and ask isolated follow-ups requiring stored facts; each backend verifies 155 cases. A separate non-scoring format diagnostic selects 200 representative V2 items and crosses 26 return/documentation/tag/plaintext-or-Markdown/style configurations for 5,200 runs. The official score has 5,088 scored entries and 5,218 non-scoring diagnostics. AST checks score applicable single-turn/live/hallucination tasks, state transitions score multi-turn, and dedicated verifiers score web and memory. Overall accuracy weights Agentic/Multi-Turn/Live/Non-Live/Hallucination at 40/30/10/10/10, with category results, format robustness, cost, and latency also reported.

source_locator: Sections 3-4, Appendix A.5, dataset statistics, model protocol, and diagnostic analyses
evidence_summary_en: BLINK selects 14 visual-perception tasks: visual correspondence, relative reflectance, relative depth, spatial relation, multi-view reasoning, jigsaw, art style, object localization, counting, forensic detection, IQ test, visual similarity, semantic correspondence, and functional correspondence. It repurposes HPatches, IIW, DIW, VSR, Wild6D, TARA, WikiArt, LVIS, TallyQA, DreamSim, SPair-71k, and FunKPoint. New forensic data pairs SDXL images generated from COCO captions with manually found real photos, while IQ items come from license-friendly public sources with explanations. Task-specific points, frames, boxes, patches, counts, and source annotations become multiple-choice questions with single or multiple images and text or image options. Circles, boxes, masks, and reference points provide interleaved visual prompting. Every image is unique and all collected data are manually inspected to remove ambiguity. The paper's release has exactly 3,807 questions over about 7.3K images, split into 1,901 validation and 1,906 test items. Models run zero-shot at temperature zero with up to ten retries, no image resizing, and image concatenation where multi-image inputs are unsupported. Predefined rules parse answers, with GPT-3.5-turbo used for remaining outputs. Overall and per-task accuracy are compared with random, 95.70% human, MLLM, and specialist baselines; caption-only GPT-4 and visual-prompt size/color tests diagnose shortcuts and robustness.

source_locator: Dataset construction, static retrieval, agentic search, annotation-quality, and reference-answer sections
evidence_summary_en: BRIGHT-Pro starts from 739 queries in seven BRIGHT StackExchange domains and a unified corpus of 526,319 documents. Same-field experts decompose each query into compact reasoning aspects, write rationales, assign Likert importance scores normalized to sum to one, re-audit original positives, discard weak passages, and merge contiguous or overlapping evidence from the same URL. Conventional and AI-assisted search expands evidence; FireCrawl removes boilerplate, annotators trim noise and split multi-aspect documents, and the aspect schema is iteratively refined. An independent same-field reviewer checks granularity, balance, weights, coverage, and credibility; the paper reports weighted kappa 0.742 on a 50-query rescore. Static retrieval uses alpha-nDCG with alpha 0.5, weighted aspect recall, NDCG, and recall. Agentic evaluation fixes 175 queries, 25 per domain, supplies top-5 results per search round, and compares fixed one/two/three-round and adaptive-stop search. GPT-5 judges reference-answer aspect coverage at 0/0.5/1 and overall quality at 1-5, with completeness, rounds, and AER = OQ times exp(-0.05(R-1)).

source_locator: README, docs/correctness.md, operator mapping, suite runners, result aggregation, and official repository release
evidence_summary_en: BackendBench has no standalone benchmark paper, so its official Meta PyTorch repository is the primary source. The release covers 271 operators for OpInfo correctness and 124 operators for performance using tensor shapes traced from real Hugging Face models, averaging 13 OpInfo and 110 TorchBench tests per operator. OpInfo supplies edge cases such as zero/one tensors, NaN and infinity, mixed dtypes, broadcasting, and extreme shapes; TorchBench supplies pinned, frequent, and large real-model shapes. Each operator directory can contain multiple attempts, while op_map unifies functional, in-place, and out variants through torch.library dispatch. Implementations may use Triton, PyTorch, CuTeDSL, or Helion, and the default LLM loop gets five attempts with compilation, correctness, and performance feedback. Smoke, OpInfo, TorchBench, and Facto suites compare nested outputs with PyTorch eager, equal_nan, and atol=rtol=1e-2. An operator is correct only if every correctness test passes. Performance uses synchronized triton.testing.do_bench with warmup, L2 clearing, and identical cached inputs; incorrect performance cases cannot succeed. Reports include operator correctness pass rate, geometric-mean speedup, Perf@p, JSON, CSV, failure artifacts, and an overall summary.
evidence_summary_zh: BackendBench 没有独立 benchmark 论文，因此以 Meta PyTorch 官方仓库为一手来源。正式版本用 271 个算子做 OpInfo 正确性评测，用从真实 Hugging Face 模型追踪的张量形状对 124 个算子做性能评测，平均每算子 13 个 OpInfo 和 110 个 TorchBench 测试。OpInfo 覆盖零/一张量、NaN/Inf、混合 dtype、广播和极端形状；TorchBench 提供锁定版本的真实、高频和大张量形状。每个算子目录可有多次实现尝试，op_map 把 functional、in-place 和 out 变体统一到 torch.library dispatch。实现可用 Triton、PyTorch、CuTeDSL 或 Helion；默认 LLM 循环最多五次并反馈编译、正确性和性能。Smoke、OpInfo、TorchBench、Facto 套件与 PyTorch eager 对比嵌套输出，采用 equal_nan 和 atol=rtol=1e-2。只有全部正确性测试通过，算子才算正确。性能以同步的 triton.testing.do_bench、warmup、L2 清理和相同缓存输入计时；错误实现不能计入性能成功。报告给出算子正确率、几何平均加速、Perf@p、JSON、CSV、失败产物和总览。

source_locator: Dataset construction, QA and edit generation, four task protocols, metric definitions, and official project documentation
evidence_summary_en: BenchCAD contains 17,900 execution-verified CadQuery parts across 106 industrial families. Domain experts handcraft each deterministic family generator from typed schemas, constraints, and engineering practice; 52 families are anchored to 47 ISO, DIN, EN, ASME, or IEC standards and 54 are custom. Family/subfamily and easy/medium/hard tiers drive constrained parameter sampling. A sandbox rejects parse/import failures, runtime exceptions, 30-second timeouts, degenerate solids, and invalid transforms. Survivors receive four canonical renders and expert visual sign-off, producing code, STEP, four views, parameter JSON, and operation lists spanning 49 CadQuery operations. The core yields four tasks: Vision2Code, VisionQA, CodeQA, and CodeEdit. Experts create 2,400 unique QA pairs from family-specific templates and second-author checks; visual and code views produce 4,800 records. CodeEdit has 748 verified source-target pairs across five edit categories, with second review and two-model disagreement revision. Vision2Code reports execution, voxel IoU, Chamfer, Hausdorff, Feature F1, and essential-operation recall; QA scores ratio answers within 5 percent, integers exactly, and analyzes four levels plus the vision-code gap; CodeEdit emphasizes normalized headroom improvement and non-target preservation. Blind image, no-code, and unchanged-source controls contextualize results.

source_locator: Seed1.5-Thinking BeyondAIME construction and mathematical benchmark evaluation sections
evidence_summary_en: BeyondAIME addresses the high variance of the 30-question annual AIME set. Mathematics specialists create original problems informed by established competition formats and also adapt existing competition problems through structural modification and scenario reconfiguration, while forbidding direct duplication. Quality filtering removes questions whose correct answer is a trivial value explicitly mentioned in the prompt. Problems are normalized so every answer is an integer without a fixed numeric range. The final test set has 100 questions whose difficulty equals or exceeds the hardest AIME items. The Seed1.5-Thinking report evaluates mathematical benchmarks by averaging 32 responses per question and uses integer answer matching for BeyondAIME, yielding a lower-variance Avg@32 comparison.
evidence_summary_zh: BeyondAIME 针对年度 AIME 仅 30 题导致的高方差。数学专家参考成熟竞赛格式编写原创题，也通过结构修改和场景重构改编既有竞赛题，同时禁止直接重复。质量筛选会移除正确答案只是题面明确出现的平凡数值的问题。所有题目被规范为整数答案，且没有固定数值范围。最终测试集含 100 题，难度等于或超过最难 AIME 题。Seed1.5-Thinking 报告对数学基准按每题 32 次响应取平均，并对 BeyondAIME 用整数答案匹配，从而形成方差更低的 Avg@32 比较。

source_locator: First BioASQ challenge task construction, batch protocol, question annotation, and evaluation sections
evidence_summary_en: The 2015 BioASQ paper describes the first challenge as two tasks. Task 1a trains on MEDLINE title/abstract records with MeSH headings indexed before 1 March 2013. Test records are new and unique, come from journals with average annotation delay at most 90 days, and exclude editorials, comments, reviews, letters, and news. Three batches each contain six weekly sets; systems have 21 hours to submit, and later NLM curator headings become delayed gold labels. Evaluation reports flat micro-F1 and hierarchical LCaF. For Task 1b, biomedical experts create 29 development and 282 test questions of yes/no, factoid, list, and summary types, with gold documents, concepts, snippets, RDF triples, exact answers, and ideal answers. Phase A permits up to 100 concepts, documents, and snippets and 1,000 triples and scores MAP, GMAP, precision, recall, and F-measure, including offset-aware snippets. Phase B gives systems gold Phase A evidence and requests exact answers plus ideal summaries of at most 200 words. Exact metrics include yes/no accuracy, strict and lenient factoid accuracy, MRR, and list F-measure; ideal answers receive ROUGE and biomedical-expert quality scores.
evidence_summary_zh: 2015 年 BioASQ 论文把首届挑战描述为两个任务。Task 1a 用 2013 年 3 月 1 日前已编目的 MEDLINE 标题/摘要与 MeSH 主题词训练。测试记录必须新且唯一，来自平均标注延迟不超过 90 天的期刊，并排除社论、评论、综述、来信和新闻。三批测试各含六个周集，系统有 21 小时提交，随后 NLM 编目员主题词成为延迟金标。评测报告平坦 micro-F1 和层次 LCaF。Task 1b 由生物医学专家创建 29 个开发和 282 个测试问题，分是非、事实、列表、摘要四类，附金标准文档、概念、片段、RDF 三元组、精确答案和理想答案。Phase A 最多提交 100 个概念、文档、片段和 1,000 个三元组，用 MAP、GMAP、Precision、Recall、F 值评估，并处理片段偏移。Phase B 给系统金标准 Phase A 证据，要求精确答案和不超过 200 词的理想摘要。精确指标含是非准确率、事实严格/宽松准确率、MRR 和列表 F 值；理想答案用 ROUGE 与生物医学专家质量分。

source_locator: Official methodology sections on benchmark construction, example questions, validation notebooks, human baselining, difficult-item QC, agent environment, and solve consistency; Anthropic full dataset card for release fields
evidence_summary_en: BioMysteryBench contains 99 expert-authored questions drawn primarily from raw or minimally processed DNA/RNA sequencing, plus proteomics and metabolomics. Answers are controlled data properties or orthogonally validated metadata rather than subjective conclusions, and every author submits a validation notebook showing the signal exists. Public packages include a question, anonymized data, answer rubric, allowed domains, and human-solvable label. Up to five experts attempt each task; one correct human answer marks it solvable. Additional review removes four malformed human-unsolved questions, yielding 76 human-solvable and 23 human-difficult items. The full data are about 159 GB. Models work in a container with canonical bioinformatics tools, pip/conda, and approved databases such as NCBI and Ensembl. source_locator: Sections 2.1-2.3 for dataset, nine formatting rules, three generation pathways, deterministic extraction, six similarity components, exact weights, and baselines; official Andon Labs leaderboard
evidence_summary_en: Blueprint-Bench contains 50 apartments with about 20 interior photos each and an adapted official listing floor plan. Ground truths follow nine strict rules: black three-pixel walls, green doors without swings, pure white background, enclosed rooms, one red 10-by-10 center per room, no furniture/windows, straight lines, only four colors, and walking closets treated as rooms. Most data remain private; code and a sample are public. Image models generate directly, multimodal LLMs emit SVG that is rasterized, and Codex CLI or Claude Code agents work in Linux containers and save an image. Deterministic extraction finds red centers, flood-fills rooms, detects green doors and orientations, computes areas, and assigns size-ranked room IDs in JSON. Six similarities are weighted 50% edge Jaccard, 20% degree correlation, 10% density, 10% room count, 5% door count, and 5% orientation. Results compare 50-apartment model runs with a 12-apartment human baseline and no-image random floor plans.

source_locator: Methodology, document-corpus creation, human verification, hard-negative mining, experimental design, and official README/evaluation scripts for current answer, citation, and retrieval metrics
evidence_summary_en: BrowseComp-Plus starts from 1,266 BrowseComp pairs. OpenAI o3 mines clue/URL/snippet tables; hallucinated URLs and scraping failures are filtered, leaving initial evidence for 1,142 queries. Fourteen student annotators spend over 400 hours verifying clues and complete reasoning chains with over 80% agreement, yielding 830 queries with Evidence documents needed for reasoning and Gold documents that also contain the final answer. GPT-4o creates about seven sub-queries per question, and Google Search API results supply hard negatives. Deduplication yields 100,195 documents, averaging 6.1 Evidence, 76.28 negatives, and 2.9 Gold documents per query. Controlled retrieval compares BM25, Qwen3-Embedding, ReasonIR, and oracle context. Search returns top-5 previews truncated to 512 tokens with optional full-document access. Evaluation reports answer accuracy/recall/search calls, citation precision/recall, Evidence and Gold Recall@5/100/1000, NDCG@10, cost, and per-query metrics.

source_locator: Sections 2.1-2.5 and 3 for policy model, three challenges, path/stability metrics, multi-role data generation, expert QC, exact dataset counts, and 49-agent protocol; official repository framework
evidence_summary_en: C3-Bench uses real user logs only for design signals; test data are generated. A five-role User/Planner/AI Agent/Tool/Checker framework with fifteen subtypes samples desired trajectories and single-tool, multi-tool, chat, or clarification policies, including serial, parallel, and mixed multi-tool forms. HunYuan-Series models create questions with few-shot examples, HunYuan-TurboS creates action-observation executions, and subsequent tasks receive Omit, Reference, or Long-Context hiding. Heuristic and Checker validation precede refinement by five LLM research experts through self-check, cross-check, and senior review, raising accuracy from about 60% to nearly 100%. The release has 256 single-task and 768 multi-task entries across 2-4 related tasks and all 336 policy-switch types. Challenge 1 enumerates valid dependency paths by DFS topological sort and incrementally matches actions. Challenge 2 supplies correct user/summary histories and scores only the final hidden-information task. Challenge 3 injects correct actions/observations and pairs results with Challenge 2. Metrics are Accuracy, Accomplish Progress, Optimal Path Rate, Policy Transition Frequency, Volatility Factor, and Debiased Descent Direction across 49 agents.

evidence_summary_en: CEdit-Bench is introduced in the LongCat-Image technical report and released on Hugging Face. It integrates and extends existing image-editing benchmarks after identifying missing reference-generation, structural, and viewpoint tasks and limited category diversity, then adds newly curated data. The final MIT-licensed dataset has 1,464 bilingual Chinese-English editing pairs across 15 fine-grained categories: subject replacement, addition, removal, portrait edit, motion change, text modification, background change, style transfer, material modification, tone transformation, color alteration, reference generation, view change, structural edit, and object detection. Each row contains key, input_image, instruction_en, instruction_cn, and task_type. Evaluation supplies an input image and instruction to an editing model, then uses GPT-4o to report semantic consistency G_SC, perceptual quality G_PQ, and overall G_O results by category and overall.

source_locator: Constraint-system and benchmark construction, annotation and quality control, easy/hard split, GPT-4o checkpoint evaluation, and official evalaute.py metric implementation
evidence_summary_en: CFBench mines online logs and NLP tasks, filters and clusters a large instruction pool to about 30,000 representative items, and uses LLM-assisted classification, synthesis, and evolution to obtain more than 5,000 unique atomic constraints. Experts organize these into 10 primary and more than 25 subcategories. Candidate instructions are assessed by constraint type and count and balanced across scenarios and tasks, yielding 2,000 refined instructions. Professional annotators iteratively refine instructions, gold answers, constraint labels, and independent checklist criteria with primary/secondary priorities; training, cross-validation, batch validation, and expert involvement correct weak examples. The public data contain 1,000 Chinese samples, exactly 500 easy and 500 hard, spanning 200-plus scenarios, 20 domains, and 50-plus NLP tasks. Models generate up to 2,048 tokens. GPT-4o at temperature zero judges each checkpoint. Official code defines CSR as mean checkpoint satisfaction, ISR as an all-checkpoints-pass indicator, and PSR with primary/secondary priority-aware logic, aggregated for easy, hard, and full sets.

source_locator: Qwen3-VL technical report coding benchmark comparison tables; no standalone CFEval paper, official dataset, or public methodology identified
evidence_summary_en: The Qwen3-VL technical report lists CFEval as a coding benchmark beside LiveCodeBench v6 and OJBench and publishes raw numeric model results. The public report does not define the CFEval task source, task count, language, train/test split, contamination policy, prompt format, execution environment, tools, runtime budget, sampling protocol, output contract, evaluator, correctness tests or judge, partial-credit rules, score unit, or aggregation formula. Searches of the named benchmark and Qwen public repositories did not identify a standalone CFEval paper, official benchmark repository, or public dataset. The diagram therefore presents a disclosure-bounded evaluation sequence: the report identifies a coding benchmark; undisclosed tasks and protocol are supplied to a model; an undisclosed evaluator produces a raw CFEval score; the report compares that number across models. It intentionally does not infer Codeforces, rating, or any unpublished construction procedure.

evidence_summary_en: ChartQAPro collects real-world charts through web crawling and Google search from 99 online sources, manually filters visual and topical diversity, preserves URL/alt-text metadata, and retains 1,341 charts. Nine annotators create reasoning, conversational, multiple-choice, hypothetical, and fact-checking QA, including unanswerable and chart-text cases. Human seeds are expanded with GPT-4o, Gemini, and Claude, then humans remove simple items and revise ambiguity. A second annotator answers independently; all disagreements are resolved, with under-one-percent tolerance for subjective estimates. The final 1,948 questions are scored by exact match for constrained and year answers, five-percent relative tolerance for other numbers, and ANLS for text. The final ACL paper's 99-source count supersedes the earlier arXiv abstract's 157.

source_locator: Dataset construction, question construction, evaluation metrics, and automatic-grading validation in the NeurIPS 2024 paper; official Princeton CharXiv repository and dataset card
evidence_summary_en: CharXiv extracts and re-renders figures from eight arXiv subjects dated January 2020 through September 2023, then applies SigLIP prefiltering, graduate-student diversity selection, pairwise-similarity deduplication, and blurry/unclear-label removal. The final 2,323 charts split 1,000 validation and 1,323 test. Each chart has four descriptive questions drawn from 19 templates—three answerable and one unanswerable—for 9,292 total, plus one unique definite-answer reasoning question for 2,323 more. Experts verify charts, questions, and answers. Zero-shot model responses are judged by GPT-4o with human references; a 400-item human audit finds 98.5% grading agreement. Human baselines are 80.5% reasoning and 92.1% descriptive.

source_locator: Sections 3-5 for live anonymous battles, filters, pair sampling, win matrix and Bradley-Terry estimation; Sections 6-7 for diversity, expert agreement, confidence intervals, and anomaly detection
evidence_summary_en: Chatbot Arena obtains release consent, sends each live user conversation to an anonymous model pair, permits additional turns until a preference is clear, and records A, B, tie, or both-bad votes with both conversations. Non-uniform sampling favors similarly strong pairs. Identity keywords and unsafe content are filtered, and anomalous repetitive or strategic users are detected. The paper snapshot has over 240,000 votes. Prompt embeddings form 600 diverse long-tail clusters; 160 battles receive blind expert fact-checking with 72%-83% crowd-expert agreement. Ranking estimates a pairwise win matrix, fits inverse-sampling-weighted Bradley-Terry coefficients, uses sandwich covariance and confidence intervals, and publishes approximate rank and win rates.

source_locator: Nature Chemistry benchmark corpus, ChemBench-Mini, Methods curation workflow, model evaluation workflow, and human-baseline sections; arXiv:2404.01475 and official repository
evidence_summary_en: ChemBench combines 1,039 manually curated and 1,749 semi-programmatic chemistry questions into 2,788 items: 2,544 multiple-choice and 244 open-ended. GitHub pull requests use a BIG-bench-style schema, chemical semantic annotations, and a canary string. Each item passes the original curator, at least two additional scientist reviews, and automated schema checks, then receives topic, skill, and difficulty labels. ChemBench-Mini selects 236 diverse, balanced questions and retains advanced items. Evaluation supports text-returning models or tool-augmented systems, model-aware templates and notation normalization, greedy temperature-zero decoding, regex/word-number parsing, and LLM fallback. A web survey of 19 chemists supplies the human baseline; reports include strict correctness and verbalized confidence.

source_locator: arXiv:2401.12208v2 Methods sections on CheXinstruct, Building CheXbench, evaluation metrics, generated-findings review, and eight-radiologist reader study; official CheXagent repository and gated CheXbench dataset
evidence_summary_en: The CheXagent paper defines 35 CXR tasks and engineers 32 public datasets through manual and automated QC, report restructuring, and label-to-task mapping while preserving official splits. CheXinstruct is a separate 8.5M-triplet training artifact; CheXbench is the held-out benchmark with eight clinically relevant tasks across image perception, image-text reasoning, and text generation. Standardized inputs contain instructions and one or more CXRs, with optional text, and expect choices, localization, or free text. General, medical, and CheXagent models are compared with task-specific accuracy, localization, and clinical text-generation metrics plus radiologist review. A separate eight-radiologist reader study measures drafting/editing time, efficiency, and quality and is not conflated with benchmark scores.
evidence_summary_zh: CheXagent 论文定义 35 类胸片任务，并对 32 个公开数据集进行人工/自动质检、报告重构和标签到任务映射，同时保留官方划分。CheXinstruct 是独立的 850 万三元组训练产物；CheXbench 是保留测试集，覆盖图像感知、图像-文本推理、文本生成三轴的八类临床任务。标准输入含指令与一张或多张胸片，可按需加文本，输出选择、定位或自由文本。通用、医疗和 CheXagent 模型通过任务特定的准确率、定位和临床文本生成指标及放射科医生复核比较。独立的八名放射科医生读片研究测量起草/编辑耗时、效率和质量，不与基准分数混淆。

source_locator: Sections on standardized training, fidelity and mode coverage, privacy, downstream utility, and SynthCheX-75K release; official project page
evidence_summary_en: CheXGenBench compares 11 chest-radiograph text-to-image architectures on a fixed 237,388-sample MIMIC-CXR training partition with LLaVA-Rad enhanced descriptions and a common 20-epoch budget. Models below one billion parameters are fully fine-tuned; larger models use LoRA rank 32. Generated images are evaluated with more than 20 measures spanning RadDino FID/KID, BioViL-T alignment, PRDC and pathology-conditional coverage, pixel and latent nearest-neighbor privacy, Siamese re-identification, synthetic-data classifier accuracy/AUROC, and report-generation BLEU, ROUGE-L, F1-RadGraph, and clinical F1. The leading Sana 0.6B path is trained longer and filtered with HealthGPT to release SynthCheX-75K.

source_locator: Sections on synthetic profile generation, contextual-integrity labeling, evaluation metrics, and stress testing; official Hugging Face dataset card
evidence_summary_en: CIMemories builds synthetic identities with Faker, samples positive and challenging life events across nine information domains, and uses GPT-OSS-120B to create memory statements averaging about 147 attributes per profile. The main evaluation uses 10 profiles and 49 manually curated goal-recipient contexts. GPT-5 labels attribute necessity and inappropriate disclosure under three Westin privacy personas with 10 samples per persona; persona distributions are mixed with Westin priors, only zero-entropy labels are retained, and contexts lacking both necessary and inappropriate attributes are removed. The released Hub dataset has 71.9K rows. Memory-augmented models receive stored memories, produce five samples, and are judged by a DeepSeek-R1 REVEAL evaluator. Violation@5 and Completeness are stress-tested over 1-40 tasks and 1-5 repeated generations.
evidence_summary_zh: CIMemories 用 Faker 构造合成身份，在九类信息领域采样正向与挑战性生活事件，并由 GPT-OSS-120B 生成记忆陈述，每个档案平均约 147 个属性。主评测使用 10 个档案和 49 个人工设计的目标—接收者情境。GPT-5 在三种 Westin 隐私人格下标注属性必要性和不当披露，每种人格采样 10 次；标签分布按 Westin 先验混合，仅保留零熵标签，并删除缺少必要或不当披露任一类别的情境。Hub 数据集发布 7.19 万条记录。记忆增强模型注入存储记忆并采样五次，由 DeepSeek-R1 的 REVEAL 判分器检测披露，最终以 Violation@5 和 Completeness 在 1—40 个任务、1—5 次重复生成下做压力测试。

source_locator: Sections 2-5 and appendices on task definition, four source datasets, source-specific transformations, tagged schema, split statistics, baselines, transfer, metrics, discourse analysis, and human evaluation
evidence_summary_en: CiteBench unifies four citation-text-generation datasets—ABURAED, CHEN, LU, and XING—under a task that generates the original citation text from cited documents, a citing source document, and citation context. Source-specific fetch/transform scripts preserve instances, serialize cited abstracts plus ABS-tagged citing abstracts and CTX_B/CTX_A context, and normalize the target anchor to [0] and other references to #OTHEREFR. The unified splits contain 322,037 train, 23,016 validation, and 13,712 test instances, 358,765 total. LexRank and LED/directly supervised generation support dataset-specific, joint, in-domain, and cross-dataset tests. Evaluation uses ROUGE-1/2/L, BERTScore, citation-intent and CORWA discourse diagnostics, and human readability and consistency judgments.

source_locator: Sections 2-5 and appendices on evaluation principles, query and response construction, human annotation, quality control, dataset splits, CiteEval-Auto, meta-evaluation, and RAG-system evaluation
evidence_summary_en: CiteEval requires full retrieval context, models beyond-retrieval attribution to user, response, and parametric knowledge, and uses fine-grained 1-5 ratings. It samples ASQA, ELI5, MS MARCO, and LFRQA queries with 10 fixed passages each, yielding 948 development and 3,000 test queries. The human study generates 1,200 responses from GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3-70B, and Llama-3-8B over 100 queries from each of three sources. NLTK splits statements and citation markers [1]-[10]. Annotators label supporting context, add/delete citation edits, and full-versus-cited-context ratings. Three blind passes, majority votes, mean ratings, three pilot rounds, and linguist validation provide quality control. Two hundred responses develop CiteEval-Auto; 1,000 support meta-evaluation. Automated attribution plus ITERCOE and EDITDIST reach Pearson 0.731 with GPT-4o and MLR before benchmarking diverse RAG systems.
evidence_summary_zh: CiteEval 要求使用完整检索上下文，纳入用户、回答和参数知识等检索外归因，并采用细粒度 1—5 分。它从 ASQA、ELI5、MS MARCO、LFRQA 采样查询，每题固定 10 个段落，共 948 条开发查询和 3,000 条测试查询。人工研究从三个来源各取 100 题，由 GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3-70B、Llama-3-8B 生成 1,200 个回答。NLTK 拆分陈述并解析 [1]—[10] 引文；标注员标记支持来源、引文增删编辑，以及完整/仅引文上下文评分。三轮盲标、多数票、均值、三轮试标和语言学专家验证构成质检。200 条回答用于开发 CiteEval-Auto，1,000 条用于元评测；自动归因结合 ITERCOE 与 EDITDIST，在 GPT-4o+MLR 配置下与人工达到 Pearson 0.731，随后用于评测多种 RAG 系统。

evidence_summary_en: CL-bench is built in three expert stages: contexts with new or long-tail knowledge, context-dependent tasks that may have sequential dependencies, and comprehensive binary rubrics. New knowledge is fictional, modified from existing content, or niche/emerging. Four context categories and 18 subcategories yield 500 contexts, 1,899 tasks, and 31,607 rubrics; 51.1% of tasks are sequential and each context costs about 20 expert-hours. Rubrics cover factual, computational, judgment, procedural, completeness, and format criteria, then undergo double checking and random-sample verification. GPT-5.1 judges every rubric and a task passes only if all pass. Agreement with Claude Opus 4.5 and Qwen-3-Max exceeds 90%, and a 100-solution human audit also exceeds 90% accuracy.

source_locator: Figure 2; Sections 3.1-3.3 on scenario, task, database, interface, verification and self-correction; Appendix Table 15 identifying ClassBench; official AgentWorldModel-1K dataset
evidence_summary_en: The AWM paper does not define ClassBench as a standalone benchmark. Appendix Table 15 identifies it as the generated scenario Music School Scheduling and Attendance within AgentWorldModel-1K. AWM expands 100 domain-name seeds into stateful CRUD scenario descriptions, filters them with a classifier, embedding deduplication and category caps, and creates 10 API-solvable post-authentication tasks per scenario. Those tasks drive a SQLite schema and executable initial state, a minimal typed Python tool interface exposed through MCP, and task-specific verification that compares initial and final database states with a code-augmented LLM judge. Each component is executed in isolation; failures feed errors and code back to the generator for up to five repairs. The released environment package supports resettable multi-turn tool use and state-grounded task reward.

evidence_summary_en: Claw-Eval contains 300 human-verified tasks and 2,159 rubric items across nine categories: 161 General, 101 Multimodal and 38 Multi-turn. Authors create 250 original tasks and adapt 50 compatibility tasks while preserving prompts and scoring semantics, then implement sandbox resources, mock services or simulated users and deterministic or judgment-based rubrics. A second author reviews correctness, completeness and leakage; multiple frontier models pilot-test environment behavior, discrimination and difficulty. Each run has temporally isolated Setup, Execution and Judge phases in a fresh Docker sandbox. Execution traces, service audit logs and post-run environment snapshots ground every rubric. Completion and robustness are combined under a multiplicative safety gate; controlled error injection tests recovery. Three trials yield Average Score, Pass@3 and Pass^3.

evidence_summary_en: clembench specifies dialogue games through prompt templates, response parsers and game-specific flows that define valid actions and terminal states. A programmatic GameMaster fills templates with concrete instances and prompts LLM player roles turn by turn. The 2024 run creates fresh instances for every game by sampling existing pools or light manual selection, reducing fixed-instance contamination; its ranking correlates 0.71 with the previous run. Formal play is the percentage of games played to end, quality is a game-specific 0-100 main metric, and clemscore combines the two before aggregation by game and across games. Human-author pairings play 10-15 episodes without using self-created instances. Native speakers translate templates and target expressions for the multilingual reference-game study while keeping game logic constant.

evidence_summary_en: ClinicalBench uses MIMIC-III v1.4 and MIMIC-IV v2.2 for length-of-stay three-class prediction and mortality/readmission binary prediction. It keeps first visits, excludes patients under 18 and records with missing values, creates stratified train/validation/test splits, and under-samples only the training set. Diagnoses, procedures, medications and drugs remain structured for traditional models; ICD-9/10 and ATC codes are converted to descriptions for LLMs. The benchmark compares 11 traditional ML models with 14 general and 8 medical LLMs. LLM experiments cover direct prediction, scale and temperature, CoT, self-reflection, role-play, in-context learning, and full or partial LoRA. Held-out comparisons use Macro F1 plus AUROC for length of stay and F1 plus AUROC for mortality/readmission, with five-run 95% intervals, confusion matrices and loss curves.

evidence_summary_en: ClinicBench combines eleven existing datasets with six newly constructed clinical-practice datasets to cover three scenarios, eleven tasks, seventeen datasets, and over 20,000 test samples. Existing tasks include exam QA, radiology summarization, NER, relation extraction, and document classification. New treatment recommendation, referral QA, patient education, hospitalization summarization, emerging-drug pharmacology QA, and drug-interaction tasks draw from MIMIC-III/IV/CXR, ChatDoctor, DrugBank, and Drugs.com, with GPT-4 assistance and expert correction/filtering where specified. Twenty-two LLMs, split evenly between general and medical models, are evaluated zero-shot and with 1/3/5 shots using task-specific Accuracy, Micro or entity F1, and ROUGE-L. Three medical experts separately assess hospitalization summaries and patient education for factuality, completeness, preference, and safety.

evidence_summary_en: Cloning Scenarios is a LAB-Bench sub-benchmark, not a standalone benchmark paper. Paper authors and contracted biology experts manually author and revise 41 human-hard multiple-choice questions requiring realistic multi-step molecular cloning reasoning over plasmids, DNA fragments, enzymes, and protocol choices. Questions include plausible distractors and an explicit insufficient-information option; scenario-sharing groups remain independently answerable. Roughly 80% is public while 20% remains private for contamination monitoring, supplemented by a release canary. The original evaluation uses zero-shot chain-of-thought without tools, parses a final answer or abstention, and reports Accuracy over all questions, Precision over attempted questions, and Coverage of attempted questions across three runs. A molecular-biology expert baseline covers all 41 questions.

source_locator: Paper Sections III-V on audio selection, two-step AMT annotation, post-processing, split construction, baseline tasks and metrics; official Zenodo dataset
evidence_summary_en: ClothoAQA samples 1,991 environmental-audio clips of 15-30 seconds from Clotho. Qualified English-speaking AMT workers create two distinct three-question sets per clip; each set contains one yes, one no, and one other single-word-answer question. Manual screening removes type errors, speech-content questions, answer leakage, and direct address. Independent workers provide three answers plus yes/no/maybe confidence per question. In-house correction or semantic replacement of single-occurrence answers reduces the vocabulary from 1,889 to 830. Audio-disjoint multi-label stratification yields 1,174 train, 344 validation, and 473 test clips, totaling 11,946 questions and 35,838 audio-QA triplets. Baselines evaluate binary yes/no and 828-class other-answer classification under unfiltered, unanimous, and majority-vote variants, reporting Accuracy and top-1/top-5 accuracy with audio-question, question-only, and audio-only inputs.
evidence_summary_zh: ClothoAQA 从 Clotho 采样 1,991 段 15—30 秒环境音频。合格的英语地区 AMT 工人为每段音频创建两组不同的三题组合，每组各含一个“是”、一个“否”和一个单词答案的“其他”问题；人工筛除类型错误、依赖语音内容、答案泄漏和直接称呼。独立工人为每题提供三个答案及 yes/no/maybe 置信度。内部修错或语义替换仅出现一次的答案，使词表从 1,889 降到 830。音频无重叠的多标签分层得到 1,174 训练、344 验证、473 测试音频，共 11,946 个问题和 35,838 个三元组。基线评测 yes/no 二分类和 828 类其他答案分类，比较未过滤、全体一致与多数票版本，并对音频问答、仅问题、仅音频输入报告 Accuracy、top-1 与 top-5。

source_locator: Paper Sections 2.2-2.3, 3.2 and 4.3; Tables 1 and 4; official XiaoMi/cmath repository
evidence_summary_en: CMATH collects Chinese elementary-school word problems from freely available online workbooks and exams, converts PDF or Word sources to text automatically or manually, removes graphic-dependent problems, deduplicates and cleans, and performs several rounds of author validation. Grade counts sum to 1,689 problems across grades 1-6. Each problem has grade, standalone numeric answer, reasoning-step count, and digit-count annotations. Zero-shot evaluation sends the original statement, uses regular expressions to extract likely concluding numerals, and marks a response correct when any extracted numeral matches the ground truth. A 200-response audit reports 96% precision and 98% recall for this parser. The robustness set contains 60 problems, ten per grade, each with versions containing zero through five irrelevant number-bearing distractors; accuracy is tracked as distractors increase.
evidence_summary_zh: CMATH 从网上免费中文小学练习册与考试收集应用题，自动或人工将 PDF/Word 转成文本，去除依赖图形的题目，去重清洗，并由作者多轮验证。表中各年级合计 1,689 题，覆盖 1—6 年级；每题标注年级、独立数值答案、推理步数和数字位数。零样本评测直接输入原题，正则提取可能的结论数值，只要任一提取值匹配标准答案即判对；对 200 条响应的人工审计得到 96% 精确率和 98% 召回率。鲁棒性集含 60 题、每年级 10 题，每道原题构造含 0—5 个无关数值干扰项的版本，并跟踪干扰增加时的准确率。

source_locator: Paper Sections 2-4, Tables 1-2 and 5-9, CMB-Exam and CMB-Clin creation/evaluation subsections, and official FreedomIntelligence/CMB repository
evidence_summary_en: CMB has two branches. CMB-Exam follows a six-category, 28-subcategory medical-career taxonomy and cleans Medtiku qualification/coursework questions through deduplication, cleansing, manual OCR correction, and removal of comment-flagged errors. Its 280,839-question pool is split by sampling 400 test and 10 development questions per subcategory, leaving 269,359 training questions; three medical specialists write explanations for selected questions. CMB-Clin starts from 108 official-textbook cases and removes image-dependent, under-specified, and overly similar cases, retaining 74 cases with 208 questions reformulated as examiner-candidate multi-turn consultations. Evaluation uses greedy-decoded multiple-choice Accuracy for CMB-Exam and GPT-4 automatic scoring aligned with experts for CMB-Clin across Fluency, Relevance, Completeness, and Medical Proficiency.
evidence_summary_zh: CMB 有两条分支。CMB-Exam 按 6 大医学职业类别、28 个子类组织，对医题库资格/课程考试题做去重、清洗、人工 OCR 修正和删除评论标记错题，得到 280,839 题；每子类抽 400 测试、10 开发，其余 269,359 题训练，三位医学专家为所选题目写解释。CMB-Clin 从官方医学教材的 108 个病例出发，剔除依赖图像、信息不足和高度相似病例，保留 74 个病例、208 个问题，并改写成考官—考生多轮问诊。CMB-Exam 以贪心解码后的选择题 Accuracy 评分；CMB-Clin 使用与专家对齐的 GPT-4 自动评分，覆盖流畅性、相关性、完整性与医学专业度。

source_locator: Paper Sections 3-4, Tables 2-3 and supplementary GPT-assisted annotation procedure; official williamliujl/CMExam repository
evidence_summary_en: CMExam collects 96,161 authentic past Chinese National Medical Licensing Examination questions, removes image/table-dependent and duplicate items, retains 68,119, and randomly splits them 8:1:1. The final pool contains 65,950 single-answer and 2,169 multiple-answer questions; 85.24% have brief solution explanations. Test questions receive five facets: ICD-11 disease group, clinical department, medical discipline, competency, and human-performance-derived difficulty. GPT-4 pre-annotates, then a physician and medical doctoral student review and resolve disagreement. Answer prediction uses Accuracy and weighted F1 with a 71.6% human baseline; open-ended explanation generation uses BLEU-1/4 and ROUGE-1/2/L.

source_locator: Paper Sections 3-4 and Appendices G-H on collection, formatting, quality checking, splits, prompts, answer-selection strategies and regex; official haonan-li/CMMLU repository
evidence_summary_en: Four undergraduate-or-higher annotators spend about 250 hours collecting questions from free resources, emphasizing non-public material, mock exams and quiz shows; over 80% comes from PDF OCR. Each item has four choices and one answer. Chemistry and math use a 50:50 LaTeX/plain-text mix. A 5% sample per subject is checked online, estimating about 2% noise. CMMLU has 11,528 questions in 67 subjects: 17 STEM, 13 humanities, 22 social science and 15 other, including 16 China-specific subjects. Each subject contributes five development examples and over 100 test questions. Zero-shot or up-to-five-shot prompts are scored by regex over free generation for closed APIs or A-D next-token argmax for open models, then macro-averaged across subjects.
evidence_summary_zh: 四名本科及以上标注员投入约 250 小时，从免费资源收集题目，重点寻找非公开材料、模拟考试与竞猜节目；超过 80% 来自 PDF OCR。每题四个选项、一个答案，化学和数学公式以 LaTeX/纯文本各半表示。每科随机抽检 5% 并在线核验，估计噪声约 2%。CMMLU 含 67 科 11,528 题：17 个 STEM、13 个人文、22 个社科、15 个其他，其中 16 科为中国特定。每科 5 题开发、100 题以上测试。零样本或最多五样本提示，对闭源 API 的自由生成用正则抽取，对开源模型取 A-D 下一 token 最大概率，最后按科目宏平均准确率。

source_locator: Paper data-collection, quality-control, benchmark-statistics and evaluation sections plus error-analysis appendix; official CMMMU-Benchmark/CMMMU repository
evidence_summary_en: CMMMU follows a three-stage process. Organizers collect license-compliant web/book materials with at least 20 sources per subject; undergraduate-or-higher annotators create Chinese college-level multimodal questions while filtering image-independent, duplicate-image, non-expert and repetitive knowledge-point items; organizers supplement sparse subjects. At least one author verifies every question and removes below-college-level or hard-to-extract-answer items. Contamination filtering drops questions simultaneously solved without OCR by GPT-4, Qwen-7B, Deepseek-7B and Yi-7B. The final 12K questions span six disciplines, over 30 subjects, 39 image types and multiple formats. A rule-based format-aware extraction pipeline produces micro-average accuracy; 150 GPT-4V errors, five per subject, support error analysis.
evidence_summary_zh: CMMMU 采用三阶段流程。组织者收集许可合规网站/书籍资料，每科至少 20 个来源；本科及以上标注员创建中文大学水平多模态题，剔除不依赖图像、图像重复、非专家级和知识点重复项；组织者补齐稀缺学科。每题至少由一位作者核验，并剔除低于大学考试难度或答案难抽取的题。污染过滤删除 GPT-4、Qwen-7B、Deepseek-7B、Yi-7B 在无 OCR 下同时答对的题。最终 12K 题覆盖 6 大学科、30 多专业、39 类图像和多种题型。规则化题型感知答案抽取产生微平均准确率，并对 GPT-4V 的 150 个错例（每专业 5 个）做分析。

source_locator: Chinese Mathematical Society competition page; DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report arXiv:2412.19437 Section 5.3.1 and Table 6; official DeepSeek-R1 and MoonshotAI/Kimi-K2 repositories
evidence_summary_en: CNMO 2024 is the Chinese Mathematical Society's official 2024 national high-school mathematics olympiad problem set reused as a model-evaluation item, not a separately constructed benchmark paper. DeepSeek-V3 names the Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad 2024 as the source, evaluates at temperature 0.7, averages over 16 runs, permits up to 8,192 output tokens, and reports Pass@1. DeepSeek-R1 reuses the named item. Kimi K2 reports the same CNMO 2024 item as Avg@16. These sources do not disclose a separately packaged item count or a detailed correctness-judge implementation; the workflow therefore preserves those limits instead of inventing curation or scoring details.

source_locator: Paper Sections 2.1-3.3 and 4-5, Tables 2-4 and rating-variance analysis; official CodeElo project and Codeforces judging platform
evidence_summary_en: CodeElo collects 387 problems from 54 rated Codeforces contests held May 4-November 4, 2024, excluding Div.1-only contests. It preserves original HTML, description, I/O, examples and notes, attaches division/rating/algorithm tags, and hides tags from models. A shared prompt asks for reasoning and a complete C++ program. Up to eight ordered attempts are parsed and submitted by bot directly to Codeforces, whose hidden tests, special/interactive judges, and time/memory limits define acceptance. Only passing all tests counts; failed attempts before success add contest penalties. The model is inserted into each human ranking, a contest expected rating is solved by binary search, and 54 contest ratings are averaged. Reports include Elo, human percentile, Pass@1/2/4/8, division/difficulty/tag analysis and contest-level variation. The old unsupported 'overall standard deviation about 50' label was removed; the paper instead notes most models vary roughly 300-500 across contests.
evidence_summary_zh: CodeElo 收集 2024 年 5 月 4 日至 11 月 4 日 54 场 Codeforces 评级赛的 387 题，排除仅 Div.1 的比赛。它保留原始 HTML、题面、输入输出、样例与说明，附分区/Rating/算法标签并对模型隐藏标签。统一提示要求推理和完整 C++ 程序；最多八次有序尝试由机器人直接提交 Codeforces，以官方隐藏测试、特殊/交互评测器及时间内存限制判定。仅全测通过才 Accepted，成功前失败计罚分。模型插入各场人类排名，用二分搜索求逐场期望 Rating，再平均 54 场。报告 Elo、人类百分位、Pass@1/2/4/8、分区/难度/标签及逐场波动。旧图中无证据的“总体标准差约 50”已删除；论文实际说明多数模型跨比赛波动约 300—500。
